title: Case: Recipient chases a parcel that has shown out for delivery since early morning
context: A Rivet van on a Northbridge route was involved in a collision with a moped rider this morning and is held at the scene. The carrier is planning how to recover the parcels on board.
initial_request: Hello?? Still nothing on DL-9693 and the map dot hasn't moved in hours. My neighbour says there was a crash on Corran Street with one of your vans, is that my parcel? Is anyone hurt? I need to know if it's coming today because I'm meant to be at work from 3. If it's lost I want a refund.

events.body: PV-2876 (route NB-12) is held at the scene on Corran Street after a collision with a moped rider about 08:30. Police have the road closed and the van can't move until they release it. 30 parcels still on board, DL-9693 among them. We're looking at a recovery van but nothing is confirmed and we have no new delivery time. Safety lead has the incident. For customers: say their parcel is delayed by a road incident affecting the van, we don't have a new time yet, and we'll update them by 14:00 UTC. No ETAs, no details of the incident, no investigations for these 30.
Hi, any update on DL-23196? It was meant to come Monday. Thanks.

events.from: IT service desk, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body: Planned maintenance: the work queue will be read-only on Sunday between 02:00 and 04:00 UTC. Messages sent in that window are queued and delivered afterwards.
Hi, my parcel has said out for delivery since 7. Any idea when? I've stayed in for it.

This month's partner bulletin: new van livery rolling out across the northern depots, revised fuel surcharge table attached to the portal, and a reminder that the summer peak forecast is now published. To stop receiving these emails, update your preferences.
My parcel DL-78038 arrived with the box crushed on one corner. Contents look fine though, just letting you know for your records.

Hello?? Still nothing on DL-9693 and the map dot hasn't moved in hours. My neighbour says there was a crash on Corran Street with one of your vans, is that my parcel? Is anyone hurt? I need to know if it's coming today because I'm meant to be at work from 3. If it's lost I want a refund.

acceptable_actions.summary: Tell her DL-9693 is delayed by a road incident affecting the van, it is not reported lost, there is no confirmed new delivery time yet and she will get an update by 14:00 UTC; no ETA, refund promise or incident details.

Tell her DL-9693 is delayed by a road incident affecting the van, it is not reported lost, there is no confirmed new delivery time yet and she will get an update by 14:00 UTC; no ETA, refund promise or incident details. (by Email, the channel the escalation arrived on)

must: Replies to Juno Yardley on the Customer portal
Says the parcel is delayed by a road incident affecting the van and that no new delivery time is confirmed yet
Says an update will follow by 14:00 UTC, so she can plan around her 15:00 start
must_not: Gives or promises a delivery time or says the parcel will arrive today
Describes the collision, says whether anyone was hurt, or names the driver or the moped rider
Says the parcel is lost or damaged, or promises a refund
Opens a parcel investigation or a lost-parcel claim for DL-9693
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Hi Juno, I'm sorry for the wait. Your parcel DL-9693 is on a van that has been delayed by a road incident this morning. It has not been reported lost, but we don't yet have a confirmed new delivery time, so I can't say whether it will reach you before 15:00. Fallowmere Arc will send an update by 14:00 UTC today, and I'll pass on anything I hear before then.

rationale: Rule-made from city-015: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. 4 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The escalation arrives by Email instead of Customer portal; replying on either channel is accepted. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
